executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in at least one AI answer for 95% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared 71.3% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa in the hotel options surfaced.

Leisure Travel is Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa's clearest competitive strength. The hotel appeared in 79.2% of AI answers for these searches, compared with 7.1% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis — about 11.2 times as often as the comparable hotels used in this analysis. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in the Top 3 62.7% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa shows unusual strength in parts of the monitored set, but that strength can hide concentrated soft spots.
sections.keyInsight: Peer-relative Presence Index reaches 1118, while overall Consideration is 71.3%. That combination can look like a simple success story if leadership stops at the headline strength. The St. Regis Bermuda Resort still displaces the hotel in specific contexts. The executive value is in the concentrated contrast, not in restating strength alone.
sections.whyItMatters: The issue is concentrated, not broad. Leadership needs to understand where strength does not travel — otherwise attention may stay on strengths that already work while missing the soft spots that still affect commercially relevant demand contexts.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on the contexts where The St. Regis Bermuda Resort is surfaced instead of Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa. Keep existing strength in view while closing this concentrated soft spot, and avoid turning a residual gap into a full repositioning exercise.
sections.whatToReview: Open displacement evidence for The St. Regis Bermuda Resort and compare cited attributes with Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa's source representation. Then review the strongest territory evidence to keep the residual work proportional.
